code_exercises.title: Log-Sum-Exp Canonical Boltzmann Weights, Partition Function & <E>
code_exercises.prompt_markdown:
Implement `canonical_boltzmann_weights(energies, kT)` for discrete microstate energies $E_i$ at thermal energy $k_B T > 0$.

- Factor out $E_{\min} = \min_i E_i$ via log-sum-exp so $w_i = \exp(-(E_i - E_{\min})/k_B T)$ never overflows or underflows all states simultaneously.
- Compute normalized probabilities $p_i = w_i / \sum_j w_j$, exact log partition function $\ln Z = -E_{\min}/(k_B T) + \ln(\sum_j w_j)$, and canonical expectation $\langle E \rangle = \sum_i p_i E_i$.
- **Returns:** `(probs, log_Z, mean_E)` with `probs.shape == energies.shape`.
